mapper.select: SELECT iv.id invoice_id, iv.doc_no, iv.invoice_date, iv.total_amount, COALESCE(s.settled_amount, 0) settled_amount, iv.total_amount - COALESCE(s.settled_amount, 0) remaining_amount FROM invoice iv LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pl.invoice_id, SUM(pl.amount) settled_amount FROM payment_line pl JOIN payment_doc pd ON pd.id = pl.payment_id WHERE pd.status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY pl.invoice_id ) s ON s.invoice_id = iv.id WHERE iv.invoice_type = #{type} AND iv.party_id = #{partyId} AND iv.status = 'confirmed' AND iv.sign = 'positive' AND iv.total_amount - COALESCE(s.settled_amount, 0) > 0 ORDER BY iv.id
